[[Antiquated Rod]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] obtained from the [[Dragrimmar Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Remnant of Antiquities]] in the [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]].

==Stats==
:[[Cold damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
